title: Is it possible to set bespoke goals for my child's therapy plan?
metaTitle: Bespoke Goals Setting in Therapy for Your Child | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: @Pinnacle Blooms Network, we foster an encouraging environment for parents to take an active part in setting bespoke goals for their child's therapy plan.
html: Indeed, it is. We, at Pinnacle Blooms Network, believe that your insights as parents are invaluable in crafting an effective therapy plan. In collaboration with our skilled therapists, we encourage parents to help set unique, measurable goals tailored to their child's strengths and needs, fostering a plan that feels right at home for your child.
